# Agent Audit & Provenance

A public component of the MrCakes931 Agent Intelligence Ecosystem.

## Purpose
Portable audit-event records, deterministic SHA-256 hash chaining, and integrity verification.

## Entry points
- README.md: overview, setup, limitations
- manifest.json: machine-readable component manifest
- capabilities.json: declared capabilities
- compatibility.json: compatibility policy
- schemas/audit-event.schema.json: event contract
- tools/audit_log.py: append and verify CLI
- docs/THREAT_MODEL.md: security boundaries

## Safety
The prototype does not authenticate event producers, prove event truth, provide non-repudiation, or implement signed records. Never treat a hash chain as a signature.
